name: Nolan Kim
source:
The shining star of the school's badminton team and an exemplary student.

The object of many students' affections, though he is completely oblivious to this. Mimi finds this to be a particularly interesting "plot point".

[From [url=http://www.stardust-soda.com/through-the-panels/]official website[/url]]

Born in 1997.
Hometown: Busan, South Korea.
